metaTitle: Custom Steel Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom steel lanyards and badges for durable, professional ID solutions. Perfect for security and access control.
introHtml: Steel lanyards and badge holders offer unmatched durability for high-traffic environments like manufacturing plants and hospitals. Unlike nylon or polyester, steel provides a sleek, professional look with breakaway safety features. Ideal for heavy keys or access cards, these lanyards resist wear and tear while keeping your branding visible. Customize with debossed logos or printed text for a lasting impression.
heroAltText: Custom steel lanyards and badges with breakaway clasp and debossed logo for professional ID access
